configurations.name: Engine (no ClickHouse)
configurations.command: cd "${input:dfeEngineDir}" && { test -f .env.e2e || cp .env.e2e.example .env.e2e; } && make e2e-server E2E_NO_CLICKHOUSE=1

configurations.name: Engine (local ClickHouse)
configurations.command: cd "${input:dfeEngineDir}" && { test -f .env.e2e || cp .env.e2e.example .env.e2e; } && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yaml up -d --wait clickhouse && make e2e-server

configurations.name: Console (next dev)
configurations.command: env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8003 INTERNAL_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8003 NEXTAUTH_URL=http://localhost:3000 NEXTAUTH_SECRET=local-dev-value corepack yarn workspace dfe-core-ui dev --port 3000

inputs.description: dfe-engine checkout, relative to this repo or absolute
